form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: How a failure of this rule is described to the model, e.g. 'interactive events name the user'.

form:FormGroup.label: XPath
form:FormGroup.helpText: Evaluated against each record; the record passes when the result is true or non-empty. Example: not(EventDetail/Authenticate) or EventDetail/Authenticate/User/Id != ''
